events.title: Community West Bancshares director Lokey acquires $1,405 common stock By Investing.com

events.title: Best-Performing Leveraged ETFs of Last Week
events.summary: Last week saw a mixed performance on Wall Street, with initial declines due to AI bubble fears, followed by a strong finish after Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell hinted at a potential September rate cut. This news led to a rally in markets, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite all experiencing gains. The article highlights several leveraged ETFs that performed well, benefiting from these market movements, including those tied to cryptocurrency, inverse AI stocks, regional banks, and cannabis.

articles.headline: Best-Performing Leveraged ETFs of Last Week

events.title: Honeywell Aerospace faces securities law probe after Q2 earnings miss and stock plunge.
events.summary: Honeywell Aerospace is facing a securities law probe by Robbins Geller Rudman & Dowd LLP after reporting a 32% drop in adjusted earnings per share for Q2 2026 and lowering its organic growth forecast, leading to a stock price fall of over 23%. The investigation will focus on potential violations of U.S. securities laws. Investors who incurred losses are encouraged to contact the firm for legal advice.

articles.headline: Honeywell Aerospace faces securities law probe after Q2 earnings miss and stock plunge.

events.title: INTU Stock Is Tumbling Despite Earnings Beat — Weak 2027 Guidance Is Weighing On Intuit Shares
events.summary: Intuit (INTU) shares dropped over 11% despite beating fiscal Q4 earnings and revenue estimates. The decline was primarily due to weaker-than-expected guidance for fiscal 2027 and Q1, with both adjusted EPS and revenue forecasts falling significantly below analyst expectations. Retail traders on Stocktwits were divided, with some viewing the sell-off as a buying opportunity and others seeing it as a sign of deeper issues.

articles.headline: INTU Stock Is Tumbling Despite Earnings Beat — Weak 2027 Guidance Is Weighing On Intuit Shares

events.title: Expion360 changes name, enters oil and gas with Louisiana deal By Investing.com
events.summary: Expion360 Inc. has changed its corporate name to Expion Energy, Inc. and is entering the oil and gas sector with the acquisition of an exploration opportunity in Eastern Louisiana for $3.4 million. Kevin Sellers has been appointed as the new CEO. The company, previously known for lithium iron phosphate batteries, will now commit up to $4 million for a leasing program and is required to drill a new lateral wellbore by February 15, 2027.

articles.headline: Expion360 changes name, enters oil and gas with Louisiana deal By Investing.com

events.title: Walmart Stock Is More Expensive Than Nvidia Amid Earnings Miss

events.title: Stagflation calls for flexibility in fixed income, not abandonment
events.summary: The article argues that stagflation, characterized by rising inflation and slowing economic growth, necessitates a flexible approach to fixed income rather than abandonment. It highlights that stagflation rarely affects all markets equally, creating regional opportunities and risks. Historically, inflation shocks are often followed by more supportive environments for fixed income returns, emphasizing the value of dynamic bond strategies that can adjust duration and invest broadly across various sectors.

articles.headline: Stagflation calls for flexibility in fixed income, not abandonment

events.title: PG&E stock holds steady as wildfire liability cap and earnings guidance support investor confidence
events.summary: PG&E's stock is trading in the high teens as investors consider new wildfire liability cap legislation, reaffirmed 2026 core EPS guidance of $1.64 to $1.66 per share, and a "moderate buy" analyst consensus with a target price of $22.20. The proposed $6 billion cap on certain wildfire liabilities and the company's consistent earnings despite potential revenue reductions from customer bill credits are key factors supporting investor confidence. The stock's current forward P/E multiple of approximately 10.7 suggests a discount reflecting lingering wildfire risks but also room for rerating if risk stabilization efforts are successful.

articles.headline: PG&E stock holds steady as wildfire liability cap and earnings guidance support investor confidence

events.title: Is Dominion Energy Stock a Buy Ahead of the September 3 Merger Vote?
events.summary: Dominion Energy (D) is facing shareholder lawsuits and political opposition ahead of its September 3 merger vote with NextEra, despite issuing supplemental proxy disclosures. events.title: Exelon stock trades close to its 52-week low as transmission approvals reshape the grid story
events.summary: Exelon stock is trading near its 52-week low, influenced by new Illinois transmission approvals and a pending multi-year grid plan that are reshaping its investment narrative. The utility's subsidiary, ComEd, received approval for a new transmission line project, reinforcing long-term grid modernization efforts, while analysts maintain a consensus "Hold" rating with an average price target of $50.07. Investors are closely watching the upcoming regulatory decision on ComEd's $15.3 billion network plan, which is crucial for Exelon's future rate base growth and earnings potential.

articles.headline: Exelon stock trades close to its 52-week low as transmission approvals reshape the grid story

events.title: Is Elevance Health (ELV) a Mispriced Opportunity?
events.summary: Sound Shore Management highlighted Elevance Health, Inc. (NYSE: ELV) as a significant contributor in its Q2 2026 investor letter. The firm views Elevance Health as a mispriced opportunity, trading below its normal valuation with double-digit earnings growth, despite investor concerns about regulatory risk and weak margins in its Medicaid and Medicare businesses. Sound Shore believes the market underestimates the strength of the franchise, citing management's focus on margin improvement, capital returns, and the use of AI tools to reduce administrative overhead and expand operating margins.

articles.headline: Is Elevance Health (ELV) a Mispriced Opportunity?

events.title: Steel Dynamics stock holds steady as tariffs and analyst calls shape the 2026 outlook

articles.headline: Steel Dynamics stock holds steady as tariffs and analyst calls shape the 2026 outlook

events.title: High Aircraft Fuel Costs Continue to Impact JetBlue’s Credit Health
events.summary: JetBlue Airways (JBLU) continues to face credit health challenges due to high aircraft fuel costs, leading to widening operating losses despite revenue growth. Activist investor Carl Icahn significantly trimmed his stake, indicating a lack of confidence in immediate returns. While JetBlue possesses substantial liquidity and unencumbered assets to manage short-term capital needs, its long-term profitability and ability to deleverage depend heavily on a more favorable macroeconomic environment and declining jet fuel prices.

articles.headline: High Aircraft Fuel Costs Continue to Impact JetBlue’s Credit Health
